<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#0f1012"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#0f1012"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#00000033"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#F7F7F7" opacity="0.08"/>
    <text x="18" y="27" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500">21:32</text>
    <g transform="translate(315,15)">
      <rect x="0" y="10" width="18" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="3" y="7" width="2" height="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="7" y="5" width="2" height="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="11" y="2" width="2" height="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="22" y="8" width="14" height="10" rx="2" ry="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="36" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="24" y="10" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="52" cy="8" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="49" y1="8" x2="55" y2="8" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="52" y1="5" x2="52" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="84" fill="#11111199"/>
    <text x="195" y="73" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Messenger</text>
    <text x="195" y="96" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700">Martha Craig</text>
    <circle cx="44" cy="87" r="18" fill="#B07676"/>
    <text x="44" y="92" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700">M</text>
    <circle cx="44" cy="87" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.3"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="87" r="4" fill="#67CE00" stroke="#0f1012" stroke-width="2"/>
    <g transform="translate(16,78)">
      <polyline points="18,0 6,10 18,20" fill="none" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <line x1="6" y1="10" x2="18" y2="10" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(314,77)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="15" y="15" width="10" height="6" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(350,76)">
      <circle cx="11.5" cy="11.5" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="11.5" y1="6.5" x2="11.5" y2="16.5" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="6.5" y1="11.5" x2="16.5" y2="11.5" stroke="#0584FE" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="138" width="354" height="192" rx="22" fill="#15181d"/>
    <rect x="19" y="139" width="354" height="192" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="183" r="48" fill="#d7b09c"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="183" r="48" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.22"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="183" r="14" fill="#67CE00" stroke="#0f1012" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="195" y="261" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700">Martha Craig</text>
    <text x="195" y="283" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF99" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400">You’re friends on Facebook</text>
    <text x="195" y="301" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Started using Messenger today</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="96" y="313" width="198" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF14"/>
      <text x="195" y="335" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Say hi and start the conversation</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Messages area -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="370" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500">Today · 8:14 PM</text>

    <!-- incoming -->
    <circle cx="36" cy="398" r="14" fill="#B07676"/>
    <text x="36" y="403" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700">M</text>
    <rect x="56" y="384" width="186" height="40" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <text x="72" y="409" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Hey Jacob, it’s Martha.</text>

    <text x="314" y="438" text-anchor="end" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500">8:16 PM</text>

    <!-- outgoing -->
    <rect x="145" y="448" width="209" height="40" rx="18" fill="#19A3FE"/>
    <text x="164" y="473" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Hi Martha! Great to hear from you.</text>

    <!-- incoming -->
    <rect x="56" y="494" width="245" height="40" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <text x="72" y="519" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400">I just got your email and wanted to</text>

    <rect x="56" y="538" width="214" height="40" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <text x="72" y="563" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400">follow up about Friday’s meeting.</text>

    <text x="314" y="585" text-anchor="end" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500">8:18 PM</text>

    <!-- outgoing -->
    <rect x="96" y="598" width="258" height="40" rx="18" fill="#19A3FE"/>
    <text x="115" y="623" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Absolutely — I’m free after 3 PM.</text>

    <!-- quick reply chips -->
    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="656" width="92" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF14"/>
      <text x="70" y="676" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">That works</text>
      <rect x="124" y="656" width="104" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF14"/>
      <text x="176" y="676" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Need details</text>
      <rect x="236" y="656" width="130" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF14"/>
      <text x="301" y="676" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Schedule a call</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- composer -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="706" width="390" height="104" fill="#11111199"/>
    <rect x="16" y="718" width="358" height="46" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF1A"/>
    <text x="64" y="746" fill="#999999" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400">Aa</text>
    <rect x="52" y="725" width="2" height="22" rx="1" fill="#0584FE"/>

    <!-- emoji -->
    <g transform="translate(24,728)">
      <circle cx="13" cy="13" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.85" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="9" cy="11" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="17" cy="11" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="8.5" y1="16" x2="17.5" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- photo -->
    <g transform="translate(92,728)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="26" height="26" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.85"/>
      <polygon points="5,19 11,12 16,17 21,9 21,20 5,20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="9" cy="8" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
    </g>

    <!-- audio -->
    <g transform="translate(132,728)">
      <rect x="0" y="4" width="26" height="18" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.85"/>
      <line x1="13" y1="7" x2="13" y2="19" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="9" y1="10" x2="9" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="9" x2="17" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- like button -->
    <g>
      <rect x="338" y="719" width="34" height="34" rx="17" fill="#19A3FE"/>
      <path d="" fill="none"/>
      <polygon points="351,725 355,725 357,729 357,734 352,739 346,734 346,729 348,725" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>

    <!-- plus / attach -->
    <g transform="translate(300,726)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF14"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="10" x2="16" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="16" x2="22" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom nav -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="778" width="390" height="66" fill="#0f1012"/>
    <rect x="0" y="778" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF1A"/>
    <g transform="translate(20,789)">
      <polygon points="18,4 8,12 28,12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="10" y="12" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
      <text x="18" y="39" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(96,787)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="15" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF80"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF80"/>
      <line x1="13" y1="19" x2="19" y2="19" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="39" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600">People</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(166,787)">
      <rect x="4" y="5" width="24" height="18" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
      <polygon points="10,10 18,14 10,18" fill="#0f1012"/>
      <text x="16" y="39" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600">Chat</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(245,787)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF80"/>
      <text x="16" y="39" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(317,787)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="14" x2="20" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="10" x2="16" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="39" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
